# Structured Pivoting

Treat replanning as a first-class skill, not a failure mode.

## Triggers

Pivot when new facts contradict sequence assumptions; when the same verification fails twice with the same theory; when impact grows faster than confidence.

## Pivot contents

State what was wrong in the prior plan, what evidence forced the change, and the next smallest executable step.

## Anti-pattern

Do not layer compensating actions while the root inconsistency remains unexplained.
